## Appearance

Matthew Cuthbert is depicted with long gray hair framing his face. In repose, he carries a slight, kindly smile.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXVII. The Reaper Whose Name Is Death P11](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0011)_

## Personality

Matthew Cuthbert is an extremely shy and taciturn man who actively avoids being among strangers or attending places where conversation is required. Regarded by others as odd, he rarely volunteers information about anything. He exhibits a particular, almost ludicrous fear of unfamiliar female children.

## History

Matthew Cuthbert was raised at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) by a shy, quiet father. Late in life, he and his sister [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) arranged to adopt an orphan boy to help on their farm, but [Matthew](../character/matthew.md) arrived at the train station to discover that an imaginative girl named [Anne](../character/anne.md) had been sent by mistake. Fond of [Anne](../character/anne.md) from the start, [Matthew](../character/matthew.md) convinced her to apologize after an outburst with Mrs. [Lynde](../character/lynde.md) so she could stay, later surprising her with sweets as she settled into the home.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised P5](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0005), [v1 CHAPTER I. ## Relationships

### [Anne](../character/anne.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne--matthew-cuthbert.md)

[Matthew](../character/matthew.md) acts as a quiet ally and defender for [Anne](../character/anne.md) after she arrives at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables). He sympathizes with her deeply, often intervening on her behalf, such as secretly convincing her to apologize to Mrs. [Lynde](../character/lynde.md) so she can make amends, and offering her small gifts like chocolates. Their bond remains tender and supportive throughout her upbringing until Matthew's sudden death from shock following a bank failure.

- Friend of — sympathizes with her and takes her part  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER X. Anne’s Apology P2](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0002)</sub>

### [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/marilla-cuthbert--matthew-cuthbert.md)

[Matthew](../character/matthew.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) are brother and sister who live together at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), managing the household and farm jointly. While [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) approaches raising [Anne](../character/anne.md) with strict discipline and practical concern, Matthew's gentle sympathy for the girl helps temper Marilla's initial reluctance to keep her. Though they differ in their approaches to discipline, they consult regularly in the kitchen about Anne's upbringing and future.

- Sibling of — brother and sister living together at Green Gables  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised P7](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0007), [v1 CHAPTER III. Marilla Cuthbert Is Surprised P0](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0000), [v1 CHAPTER III. Marilla Cuthbert Is Surprised P1](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0001), +7 more</sub>
